items.name: UJCV Cubing Honduras 2026

venue.name: [Universidad José Cecilio del Valle](https://ujcv.edu.hn/)
venue.address: Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Boulevar Roberto Romero Larios, Comayagua

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU1NDc4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--72b0f75423beefdc650f133783cee9ed7de0cd11/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-01-13%20at%2010.05.16%20AM.jpeg) Esta competencia forma parte de una serie de tres eventos que se desarrollarán a lo largo del año 2026, coincidiendo con los tres períodos académicos. El objetivo principal de esta serie es fortalecer el desarrollo del speedcubing en Honduras, brindar más oportunidades de competencia oficial y contribuir a la mejora progresiva de los tiempos y rankings a nivel nacional. El evento se llevará a cabo en la Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, campus Comayagua, institución que brinda el espacio y apoyo logístico para la realización de competencias oficiales WCA, reconociendo el valor educativo, formativo y tecnológico del speedcubing. _______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ This competition is part of a series of three events that will take place throughout 2026, corresponding to the three academic periods. The main objective of this series is to strengthen the development of speedcubing in Honduras, provide more opportunities for official competition, and contribute to the progressive improvement of national times and rankings. The event will be held at Universidad José Cecilio del Valle, Comayagua campus, which provides the venue and logistical support for the organization of official WCA competitions, recognizing the educational, formative, and technological value of speedcubing.

Awards will be given to the top finishers in each event, and the competition will be open to participants of all nationalities, promoting fair play and the development of new talent.

items.name: Nacionales Honduras 2026

venue.name: Cinema Aventura
venue.address: Edif. Aventura, Frente al Parque Central, 50467 Siguatepeque, Hondur
venue.details: Indoor Basketball Court of Cinema Aventura

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY4NDM1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3f513686fbb74ac17d91b2b129f46c0db6a4b42/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-03-12%20at%2010.11.21%20PM.jpeg) Nos enorgullece presentar las Nacionales Honduras 2026. Será el primer Campeonato Nacional en Honduras: una celebración de destreza y agilidad. Una fiesta cubera! Todos los competidores, incluyendo los extranjeros, podrán participar y avanzar hasta las rondas finales. **Sin embargo, las premiaciones estarán reservadas únicamente para los competidores de nacionalidad hondureña.** __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ We are proud to present Nacionales Honduras 2026. It will be the first National Championship in Honduras:a celebration of skill and agility. A true cubing celebration! All competitors, including international participants, will be able to compete and advance to the final rounds. **However, awards will be reserved exclusively for competitors of Honduran nationality.**
